page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head "EPISTOLA." at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

p.i: rependi posse◡ fatendum est: longè tamen nos plura ijs debere◡, per quos veram pietatem didicimus, nemo sana mentis, opinor, negabit: per hos enim Christiani, per illos nihil amplius quàm homines sumus. Maxime vero, si quanta sit in Papismo (cui tanquam pecudes mancipati serviuimus) errorum lerna, cogitabimus, tanto nos beatiores, qui semel e tanto naufragio emersimus, feliciores(que)◡ iudicemus necesse est, eoque◡ pluris eos faciamus, per quos a Domino sumus tantum beneficium consequuti. Itaque◡ quum anno temporis vltimi M.D.LIX. Iurisconsul. ille◡ doctissimus, & Senator plane sanctissimus Anna Burgius, cui per quadriennium operam in Iure civili Aurelia dederam, effet propter puram Euangelij doctrinam Lutetia crematus, eo ipso igne◡ ad huius, quam tantum leuiter degustaram, doctrinae cognitionem assequendam acrius sum inflammatus, adeo vt me◡ totum in eorum, qui & verè & sincere illam profitebantur, scholam & disciplinam tradere◡ postea cogitarim. Nec enim temerè vel leuibus argumentis eam à tanto viro, quem toties vniversa Gallia docentem esset admirata, defendi posse statuebam. Sic factum est, vt anno sequenti, qui

page.notes: The hooks ◡ after posse, debere, feliciores(que), eoque, igne, ille, me, tradere, Itaque and the sign after Aurelia are printed contraction or ligature marks of the period; I have shown them as ◡ and did not expand them. The line "fuit" at the lower right is a catchword, set below the last full line and carried over to the next page. Long s is set as plain s throughout. u/v were normalised: intervocalic and post-consonantal u as v (civili, servivimus, universa, ultimi, tvebam); initial v kept. Reading of "tuebam" and "pluris" is somewhat uncertain given the faded impression. "Anna Burgius" is set as printed, with an ornamental initial A.
